why: Tests step for a fast-tracked lead-tooling change with no tracker ticket, on branch fabrikalfa/leakgrep-patch-added-lines, today's tooling. The owner-approved change: leakgrep's style-only em_dash check also skips the added lines inside a hunk of a pnpm patch under patches/, as it already skips the removed and context lines there; every other shape still reads them. Laws written in .agents/skills/lead/scripts/leakgrep.patches.test.ts, each a fast-check property over generated one- or two-file patches with one to three hunks, read as a diff, a pushed commit and a whole draft. Law 1, 'an em dash on any added line inside a hunk of a patches/ file passes', is red on today's leakgrep.sh: diff mode exits 1 with 'leak em_dash at added line 18'. Law 2, four places outside a hunk (a context-looking line and an added-looking line before the last file's first hunk, the diff --git line, the +++ line) and three other paths (docs/upstream@1.0.0.patch, next/patches/upstream@1.0.0.patch, notes/upstream.md), still fails: green. Law 3, a GitHub-shaped key built at run time, a machine path, the private word and a canvas link on an added line inside a hunk, still fails: green. The old law 'an em dash on an inner added line of a patches/ file still fails' asserted the rule the owner turned around; its case was taken out of that loop and law 1 holds the new rule. Every other existing leakgrep law is unchanged and green.
